children.value: This section contains some useful mappings between metadata schemes which may be useful for CDIF implementers. These include the mappings from CDIF to Persisitent Identifier (PID) Kernel attributes as defined by the RDA, and a descriptiob of how CDIF maps onto Signposting as a mechanism for Web navigation of FAIR resources.
